job.title: Senior Odoo Engineer ERP & E-Commerce (all genders)

tailoring.headline: Senior Java & SAP Commerce Engineer | ERP & E-Commerce Integration Expert
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering large-scale SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, RESTful and OCC APIs, and end-to-end integration of PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Proven record in business analysis, user story creation, and agile delivery. Skilled in CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes and cloud deployments, with strong performance tuning and production support experience.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Odoo Engineer ERP & E-Commerce
cover_en.hook: I am excited by BONAGO’s mission to blend incentive marketing with cutting-edge ERP and e-commerce solutions. With over five years designing and delivering SAP Commerce Cloud platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in end-to-end ERP integration and scalable e-commerce architectures.

bullets.label: API Integration
bullets.text: Designed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and built robust data pipelines (Profisee, Hotfolders, DataHub) that synchronized product data across ERP, MDM and e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Worked directly with business stakeholders to analyse requirements, write user stories and functional specs, translating them into SAP Commerce solutions that met ERP-driven business processes.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & CI/CD
bullets.text: Led CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) using Jenkins, Docker and Kubernetes, ensuring rapid, reliable releases in an agile Scrum environment.

bullets.label: Performance & Scalability
bullets.text: Refactored complex FlexibleSearch queries and optimized SQL performance, reducing response latency and supporting high-volume e-commerce traffic.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, invitation to talk

tailoring.why_company: BONAGO’s innovative approach to incentive-driven marketing aligns perfectly with my passion for connecting ERP data to engaging e-commerce experiences. Your focus on data-rich campaigns and seamless integration across platforms offers the ideal environment to apply my proven SAP Commerce integration expertise, while expanding into new ERP-centric challenges. I am eager to contribute my techno-functional background to help BONAGO deliver smarter, data-driven marketing solutions.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my ERP-integration and e-commerce expertise to help BONAGO build seamless, data-driven marketing platforms that drive customer engagement and business growth.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce engineer with 5+ years of ERP & e-commerce integration experience. I’m very interested in the Senior Odoo Engineer role at BONAGO and would love to discuss how my background can add value to your team.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Senior Odoo Engineer – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Odoo Engineer ERP & E-Commerce position at BONAGO. I bring over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience, strong ERP integration skills, and a proven record of delivering scalable e-commerce solutions. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your innovative projects.

Best regards,
